# Vendored OOLONG scoring code

`oolong_eval_helpers.py` is a **byte-identical** copy of the OOLONG benchmark's
scoring module, reused verbatim so ASSAY's OOLONG scores are computed by the
authors' own code (scoring parity, RESEARCH.md §1.3).

| field | value |
|---|---|
| upstream repo | https://github.com/abertsch72/oolong |
| upstream path | `src/eval/eval_helpers.py` |
| upstream commit | `0bb7eabe839218fee7fe8d007f41cfc2fd3ae24c` |
| license | MIT, Copyright (c) 2025 Amanda Bertsch (see `LICENSE.oolong`) |
| vendored sha256 | `247583a3b653b91c39fb88a102460802f1493175b23d05a7217aead0d685c64c` |

The file is imported through `bench/oolong/scorer.py`, which stubs the heavy /
paid dependencies (`litellm`, `datasets`, `tiktoken`, `transformers`,
`jsonlines`) and shims `dateutil` so the module loads and scores with **zero
network, zero API keys, and no model**, exactly the isolation the M0 spike
proved (`oolong-spike/scorer_isolation.py`).

Functions used:
- `synth_process_response(datapoint, output, model)`, the OOLONG-synth scorer:
  exact match; `0.75**|gold-pred|` numeric partial credit; DATE via `strptime`
  gold + parsed model output.
- `dnd_process_response(datapoint, output, model)`, the OOLONG-real (DnD) scorer:
  int partial credit, string exact, list set-overlap. (Available for the real
  split; M1 packs are synth.)

Do not edit this file. To update the pin, re-copy from the upstream commit and
update the sha256 above and in `PROTOCOL.md`.
